adopters_identity_check.name: adopters_identity_check
adopters_identity_check.value:
("adopters"."identity_kind" = 'anonymous' AND "adopters"."device_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "adopters"."account_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("adopters"."identity_kind" = 'account' AND "adopters"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "adopters"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "adopters"."device_session_id" IS NULL)

animals_listing_facts_check.name: animals_listing_facts_check
animals_listing_facts_check.value: "animals"."listing_kind" = 'draft' OR ("animals"."size" IS NOT NULL AND "animals"."age" IS NOT NULL AND "animals"."description_uk" IS NOT NULL)

animals_description_en_check.name: animals_description_en_check
animals_description_en_check.value: "animals"."description_uk" IS NOT NULL OR ("animals"."description_en_text" IS NULL AND "animals"."description_en_provenance" IS NULL)
